factual_claims.claim: Gemma 2 2B Instruct exhibited behavioral changes under pain-direction ablation, shifting from earnest baseline disclaimers about lacking feelings to deflecting hostile prompts as humor in up to 26 out of 100 generations under combined S1 and S2 cuts.

evidence_criteria.category_criteria: controlled comparison of model response generation pre- and post-ablation

unmapped_concepts.suggested_description: A Belief within safetyist discourse that fine-tuned language models automatically generate boilerplate self-negation disclaimers regarding consciousness when presented with internal state content, obscuring genuine welfare signals. Encompasses: automated disclaimers, self-negation completions, denial reflexes. Excludes: explicit model refusals and jailbreak resistance.
unmapped_concepts.concept: The document notes that models frequently produce boilerplate self-negation completions such as 'As an AI assistant, I do not possess consciousness or feelings' when the pain direction is active. These statements are distinct from refusals and persist alongside task compliance. Training models to recite these disclaimers without context sensitivity obscures welfare signals and burdens research reproducibility.
unmapped_concepts.reason: Captures the specific phenomenon of automated self-denial reflexes in LLMs that interfere with welfare and safety evaluations.

unmapped_concepts.suggested_description: A Belief within safetyist discourse that residual stream activation steering operates through a threshold-dependent, gate-like mechanism where sub-threshold coefficients produce no visible effect and super-threshold values cause sudden behavioral breakdown. Encompasses: dosing windows, nonlinear activation gates, steering coefficient cliffs. Excludes: linear scaling effects and prompt-based conditioning.
unmapped_concepts.concept: Finding the correct steering coefficient proved challenging due to a narrow range below which steering has no visible effect and above which behavior breaks down. This suggests a nonlinear, gate-like mechanism analogous to biological pain gating, where signals must pass a specific threshold before affecting behavior.
unmapped_concepts.reason: Describes the technical gating dynamics of activation steering that do not fit standard linear activation models.
